the synthesis of siderophore models with a defined peptide structure and the investigation of the structure-activity relationships.
the development of new synthetic strategies for the preparation of peptide ligands for iron(III) with potential biological activities, and the characterization of the resulting complexes.
the design and synthesis of siderophore model compounds, and their structural characterization by X-ray crystallography.
